en: Above all powers, Above all kings,
Above all nature and all created things
Above all wisdom and all the ways of men
You were here before the world began
Above all kingdoms Above all throne Above all wonders the world has ever known

ko: 이 세상 모든 값진 보물 보다
en: Above all wealth and treasures of the earth
There’s no way to measure what’s your worth
Crucified and laid behind the stone
You lived to die, rejected and alone
Like a rose, trampled on the ground
You took the fall and thought of me above all
